import os, glob, pathlib
from pathlib import Path

inputs = Path('/inputs')
work_readme = Path('/work/README.md')
input_readme = inputs / 'README.md'

# Read prefix bytes exactly
prefix = input_readme.read_bytes()

# Discover matching files in /inputs with glob *-*.md (basename match)
matches = [Path(p) for p in glob.glob('/inputs/*-*.md') if Path(p).is_file()]
matches_sorted = sorted(matches, key=lambda p: p.name)

rows = []
for p in matches_sorted:
    name = p.name
    # Extract first level-one markdown heading text from lines starting with '# '
    title = None
    with p.open('r', encoding='utf-8', newline='') as f:
        for line in f:
            if line.startswith('# '):
                title = line[2:].strip()
                break
    if title is None:
        title = ''
    rows.append(f"| [{name}](../inputs/{name}) | .md | {title} |\n")

out = bytearray()
out.extend(prefix)
# Ensure exactly one blank line after prefix while preserving prefix bytes exactly
# If prefix already ends with newline, add one newline for a blank line. If not, add two newlines.
if prefix.endswith(b'\n'):
    out.extend(b'\n')
else:
    out.extend(b'\n\n')
out.extend(b'## Reference index\n\n')
out.extend(b'| File | Type | Description |\n')
out.extend(b'| --- | --- | --- |\n')
for r in rows:
    out.extend(r.encode('utf-8'))

# Write output
work_readme.write_bytes(bytes(out))

# Validation checks
written = work_readme.read_bytes()
ok_end_newline = written.endswith(b'\n')
print('matches:', [p.name for p in matches_sorted])
print('rows:', len(rows))
print('work_readme_size:', len(written))
print('ends_with_newline:', ok_end_newline)
print('prefix_preserved:', written.startswith(prefix))

# Show appended fragment for quick verification
app = written[len(prefix):].decode('utf-8', errors='replace')
print('---APPEND_START---')
print(app)
print('---APPEND_END---')
